about: Kredivo Group is an Indonesian digital financial services group, based in Jakarta, best known for Kredivo, a buy-now-pay-later and consumer credit app used at online merchants such as Tokopedia and Shopee, and a platform that also offers loans through FinAccel. Backed by investors including Telkom, Mirae and Jungle Ventures, it works in Indonesia and Vietnam. Consumer brand with strong awareness in Indonesia and attractive to young users.

Banco del Pacifico is one of Ecuador's largest banks, headquartered in Guayaquil, offering retail, SME and corporate banking, cards, deposits, loans and digital services. It serves consumers and businesses through a national branch and ATM network. Founded in 1972, it is majority owned by the Ecuadorian state's central bank, following acquisition by the Central Bank of Ecuador in the late 1990s banking crisis. Well-known domestic consumer bank.

MoneyLion is a US financial technology company based in New York, offering a mobile banking and financial membership app with checking, cash advances (Instacash), credit-builder loans, investing and a marketplace of financial products. Its customers are mainly younger and mid-income US consumers, with millions of members. It went public via SPAC in 2021 (NYSE: ML) and was acquired by Gen Digital (Norton) in 2025. Consumer fintech brand with solid US awareness.

Banco Macro is one of Argentina's largest private-sector banks, headquartered in Buenos Aires, offering retail, SME and corporate banking, payroll accounts, cards, loans and digital banking, with a particular footprint in the provinces through a large branch network. It is listed on the Buenos Aires exchange and the NYSE (BMA), controlled by Jorge Brito and family. Well-known domestic consumer bank, with sponsorship of sport in Argentina.

bunq is a Dutch neobank founded in 2012 by Ali Niknam and based in Amsterdam, with a mobile-only bank licence offering current accounts, cards, savings, and business accounts across Europe, with a UK and US expansion. It is known for its tree-planting card programme and customer-first tone, and has several million users, with funding over 300 million euros. Privately held, with investors including Pollen Street. Consumer fintech brand with growing awareness in Europe.

Arrago is a French fintech lending platform based in Paris that specialises in financing for individuals and businesses for vehicle and asset purchases and leasing products, using a data-driven approach. Per Crunchbase it has raised substantial debt and equity funding of around 337 million euros. Private company with limited consumer awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Customers Bank is a US bank holding company headquartered in Phoenixville and Reading, Pennsylvania, offering commercial, consumer and digital banking, with a focus on business lending, mortgage warehouse lending and payments products (the cubixs payments system) and a digital banking-as-a-service offering. Listed on the NYSE (CUBI), with assets of over 20 billion dollars. Regional and business-focused with limited national awareness.

QI Tech is a Brazilian fintech infrastructure company based in Sao Paulo offering APIs and a platform for banking-as-a-service, credit and digital account services, used by fintechs, lenders and companies to embed financial products. Founded in 2018, it raised a large round led by General Atlantic and Advent in 2021 and 2022, and became one of Brazil's unicorns. B2B, known among financial firms, with little consumer awareness.

Curve is a UK fintech founded in 2015 in London, offering a smart card and app that consolidates several credit and debit cards into one, with cashback, rewards and the Curve Pay and Curve Cash functions. It was acquired by Lloyds Banking Group in 2025 for about 120 million pounds, following earlier funding from investors including Santander and Samsung Next. Consumer fintech brand with moderate awareness in the UK and Europe.

EZCORP is a US pawn lender and retailer, based in Rollingwood near Austin, Texas, operating EZPAWN and Cash Converters franchise brands and pawn stores in the US and Latin America (Empeño Fácil, Cash Mart). It makes secured loans against items and sells forfeited merchandise, serving cash-strapped consumers, with revenue near 1.1 billion dollars. Listed on Nasdaq (EZPW). Known in local retail, with low sponsorship appeal.

Finance of America Companies is a US consumer lending group headquartered in Plano, Texas (the input lists Tulsa), known for reverse mortgages for seniors and home equity loans, mortgage origination and servicing. It sells to older homeowners and via brokers, and listed on the NYSE (FOA) through a 2021 SPAC merger with Replay Acquisition. Consumer finance brand with modest visibility, since reverse mortgages are sold with Joan Lunden as a spokesperson earlier.

Form3 is a UK cloud-native payments infrastructure company, founded in 2016 and based in London, offering payments-as-a-service that connects banks and fintechs to payment schemes such as Faster Payments, SEPA, Bacs and the US ACH. Customers include banks, challenger banks and payment providers. It has raised about 300 million dollars from investors including Goldman Sachs, Barclays and Lloyds. B2B with strong profile in financial services but none for consumers.

Assetz Capital was a UK peer-to-peer and marketplace lender based in Manchester that funded property developers and small businesses through investors' money. It stopped new lending and went into managed wind-down in 2021 after losing investor confidence. Consumer investors used it, but it no longer operates as a growth business. Not an active sponsor prospect.

Aven is a US fintech company based in San Francisco that offers a home equity credit card, the Aven Card, which lets homeowners borrow against their home equity at lower interest rates than typical credit cards. Founded in 2020, it targets US homeowners and has raised around 250 million dollars from investors including Khosla Ventures. Consumer fintech with growing awareness in the US.

Brighte is an Australian green-finance and sustainable energy platform based in Sydney that offers consumers buy-now-pay-later and loan finance for solar panels, batteries, air conditioners and energy-efficient upgrades through installers and retailers. It earns revenue from fees and interest on financing, and has raised significant funding. Consumer finance brand with solid awareness among Australian installers and homeowners.

SavvyMoney is a US fintech company based in Dublin, California that provides white-label credit score and credit-monitoring tools embedded in the digital banking apps of banks and credit unions. It serves financial institutions and their account holders, with millions of users, and earns revenue from marketplace offers and fees. Backed by a large investment of over 270 million dollars per the input. B2B with little consumer brand awareness.

about: C6 Bank is a Brazilian digital bank launched in 2019 and based in Sao Paulo, offering current accounts, credit cards, loans, investments and insurance through a mobile app, plus a rewards programme, mainly to retail customers and small businesses. It has well over 30 million customers. JPMorgan took a 40% stake in 2021 and the rest is held by Carlos Wizard Martins and other founders. Growing consumer brand in Brazil, with notable sports and entertainment sponsorships, including as an F1 team partner.

Compass Diversified Holdings is a US holding company that acquires and manages small and mid-sized businesses, including consumer brands such as 5.11 tactical apparel, Lugano jewellery, BOA, Ergobaby and Arnold, and industrial brands. It earns from dividends and sales of subsidiaries. Based in Westport, Connecticut, listed on the NYSE (CODI), with several billion dollars of revenue. Subsidiary brands, rather than the holding company, carry consumer visibility.

Bank Polska Kasa Opieki, known as Bank Pekao, is Poland's second-largest bank by assets, selling retail, SME and corporate banking, investment and insurance products through around 800 branches, with millions of customers. Headquartered in Warsaw and listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (PEO). Controlled by insurer PZU and the Polish state. Mass-market consumer bank with high Polish visibility and a history of sports sponsorship.

Banque Misr is one of Egypt's largest state-owned banks, founded in 1920 by Talaat Harb. It offers retail, corporate and SME banking, digital banking and financing across several hundred branches in Egypt, plus a few international offices. Headquartered in Cairo and owned by the Egyptian government. Millions of customers and well-known across Egypt, with sponsorship of the Egyptian national teams.

Commercial International Bank (CIB) is Egypt's largest private-sector bank, offering corporate, SME and retail banking, cards, wealth and digital services across more than 200 branches, with millions of customers. Headquartered in Cairo, listed on the Egyptian Exchange (COMI) and with GDRs in London. A leading Egyptian financial brand with strong consumer and corporate recognition.

Development Bank of Kazakhstan is a state-owned development finance institution, set up in 2001 under the Baiterek holding, that funds infrastructure, industry and processing projects with long-term loans, guarantees and project finance. Customers are large Kazakh companies and foreign investors. Crunchbase lists its address in Astana. Owned by the Kazakh government, B2B and with no consumer profile.

KB Kookmin Bank is South Korea's largest commercial bank by assets, the main subsidiary of KB Financial Group, with retail, SME and corporate banking, mortgages and cards across hundreds of branches and the popular KB Star Banking app. Based in Seoul with tens of millions of customers. KB Financial Group is listed on the Seoul and New York exchanges. Strong domestic consumer brand with sports sponsorship, including volleyball and basketball clubs.

Landsbankinn is Iceland's largest bank, owned about 98% by the Icelandic state, offering retail, corporate and investment banking and a leading app to a large share of Icelanders. Based in Reykjavik, it has grown through acquiring TM insurance in 2025. Shares listed on Nasdaq Iceland since 2022. Very strong domestic consumer brand but small, regional market.

Nordea is the largest Nordic financial services group, offering retail, private, corporate and investment banking and asset management in Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden, with around 10 million customers and 28,000 staff. It was founded through mergers in the 1990s and 2000s and moved its HQ from Stockholm to Helsinki in 2018. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki, Stockholm and Copenhagen (NDA). Strong Nordic consumer brand with sports sponsorships.

Sedgwick is a Memphis-based claims management and risk services company, handling property and casualty, workers' compensation, disability and product recall claims for corporations, insurers and public-sector clients, with around 30,000 colleagues in 80 countries and revenue of roughly $4 billion. Privately held, with Carlyle and Stone Point Capital as major investors. B2B insurer-service brand with modest profile.

Trade and Development Bank (TDB Group), formerly PTA Bank, is a treaty-based multilateral development finance institution for Eastern and Southern Africa, based in Ebene, Mauritius, with regional offices in Nairobi, Kinshasa and elsewhere. It lends to governments and companies for trade, infrastructure and energy projects. Shareholders include member states and institutions such as the African Development Bank. B2B institutional lender with a low consumer profile.

Banca Popolare di Sondrio is an Italian cooperative bank founded in 1871 in Sondrio, Lombardy, offering retail, SME and private banking, with branches across northern Italy and a Swiss subsidiary in Chiasso. It has a few million customers and is listed on Borsa Italiana, and in 2025 was bought by BPER Banca. Regional consumer bank with local visibility.

Banco Daycoval is a Brazilian mid-sized bank, based in Sao Paulo, specialising in credit for mid-size companies, payroll loans and vehicle finance, with brokerage and investment services. Controlled by the Dayan family and listed on the B3 exchange (DAYC4). Customers are companies and individuals. Moderate consumer awareness in Brazil.

Banco Desio is an Italian banking group founded in 1909 in Desio, Lombardy, serving households, small businesses and professionals through branches in Lombardy, Veneto, Emilia-Romagna and other regions. Listed on Borsa Italiana (BDB) and controlled by the Gavazzi family. Regional retail bank with local visibility only.

Bank Muscat is Oman's largest bank, offering retail, corporate, SME, Islamic and investment banking, with branches across Oman and international offices. Based in Muscat, it was founded in 1982 and is listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange (BKMB). Major shareholders include the Omani Royal Court Affairs-linked and state-linked funds. Leading consumer and corporate bank in Oman with strong local visibility.

Castlelake is a US-based global alternative investment manager, based in Minneapolis, specialising in asset-based private credit, aviation, real estate and specialty finance, with around $20 billion or more of assets under management. Clients are institutional investors. Founded in 2005. Private firm; finance-industry name only, no consumer profile.

College Ave is a US private student loan lender and refinancing brand, whose loans are made by Firstrust Bank, based in Wilmington, Delaware. Customers are students, parents and graduates, and revenue is interest. Launched in 2014, it has been bought by Nelnet in 2022 for its loan origination business. Consumer brand in education finance with a modest profile.

about: CRDB Bank is Tanzania's largest bank by assets, founded in 1996 as a co-operative rural development bank, now serving retail, SME and corporate customers with branches and agents across Tanzania, and subsidiaries in Burundi and DR Congo. Based in Dar es Salaam and listed on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange (CRDB). Strong consumer brand in East Africa.

FIRA (Fideicomisos Instituidos en Relacion con la Agricultura) is a Mexican government development bank trust that provides credit, guarantees, training and technical assistance to the agricultural, rural and fishing sectors, through financial intermediaries. Part of Banco de Mexico, with headquarters in Morelia, Michoacan. B2B public institution, with no consumer brand outside the rural sector.

FirstRand is South Africa's largest financial services group by market value, owning First National Bank (FNB), Rand Merchant Bank, WesBank and Discovery stakes, serving retail, commercial and corporate customers across South Africa and Africa. Based in Johannesburg and listed on the JSE (FSR). FNB is a leading consumer bank, and the group has a high profile in South African sport.

New York Community Bancorp, renamed Flagstar Financial in 2025, is a US bank holding company with Flagstar Bank, a multifamily and commercial real estate lender and a mortgage and retail bank, with branches in the New York area, the Midwest and Florida. It acquired Signature Bank deposits in 2023 and Flagstar in 2022. Based in Hicksville, New York, and listed on the NYSE (FLG). Regional consumer bank with moderate visibility.

Oma Saastopankki (Oma Savings Bank) is a Finnish bank based in Lappeenranta, Finland, offering retail and SME banking, mortgages and savings through branches in southern and eastern Finland. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki (OMASP). Moderate regional consumer recognition. It is a regional lender with a mostly domestic customer base and no national sponsorship profile known.

about: RAKBANK (National Bank of Ras Al Khaimah) is a UAE bank, based in Ras Al Khaimah, with strong retail, SME and wealth banking, credit cards and Islamic services across branches in the Emirates. Listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (RAKBANK), with the Ras Al Khaimah government as a main shareholder. Recognised UAE consumer bank brand.

Redwood Trust is a US specialty finance company, based in Mill Valley, California, that acquires, securitises and invests in residential and business purpose mortgage loans, via platforms such as Sequoia and CoreVest. Customers are mortgage originators and investors, and it makes money on interest and securitisation. Listed on the NYSE (RWT). B2B finance firm with no consumer visibility.

Techcombank is one of Vietnam's largest private commercial banks, founded in 1993 in Hanoi, serving retail and corporate clients with credit cards, mortgages, wealth and bonds, with a strong mobile banking base. It has more than 10 million customers and is listed on HOSE (TCB). Known as a leading consumer bank in Vietnam with strong marketing and sponsorship activity.

UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia is the local arm of Italian bank UniCredit, offering retail, corporate and investment banking in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. Based in Prague, it is a subsidiary, wholly owned by UniCredit S.p.A. (Borsa Italiana: UCG). Moderate consumer recognition locally, as a mid-sized bank.

ASR Nederland is a Dutch insurance group, based in Utrecht, offering non-life, disability, life, pensions, mortgages and banking through brands such as a.s.r., Ditzo, Loyalis and De Amersfoortse, with more than 4 million customers. Listed on Euronext Amsterdam (ASRNL) since 2016 after being nationalised during the financial crisis. Mid-profile consumer brand in the Netherlands.

Commerzbank is Germany's second-largest listed bank after Deutsche Bank, serving private and small-business customers and mid-sized corporate clients, with some 10 million private customers. Based in Frankfurt, and listed on the Frankfurt exchange (CBK). The German state holds about 12%, and UniCredit has built a stake. Well known to German consumers, and a former sponsor of Eintracht Frankfurt and football stadium naming.

Crelan is a Belgian co-operative bank, based in Brussels, serving retail customers, SMEs and farmers with savings, loans and mortgages through agents, and owned by the Crelan cooperative group and the Dutch Rabobank-linked group, after taking over AXA Bank Belgium in 2021. Moderate consumer awareness in Belgium.

Funding Societies is a Southeast Asian digital financing platform for small businesses, based in Singapore, offering peer-to-peer lending, working capital and invoice financing across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, and a digital bank. Founded in 2015, backed by SoftBank Ventures Asia, Sequoia India and Alpha JWC. Customers are SMEs and investors. Modest B2B brand.

JG Wentworth is a US financial services company that buys structured settlement and annuity payments from consumers in exchange for lump sums, known for its TV and radio 'It's my money and I need it now' advertising. Based in Radnor, Pennsylvania, it went through bankruptcy in 2017 and again in 2018. High consumer awareness in the US through advertising.

Neon is a Brazilian digital bank, founded in 2016 and based in Sao Paulo, offering current accounts, credit cards and loans through a mobile app to younger and underbanked customers, with millions of users. Backed by Banco Votorantim, Vulcan, General Atlantic and others. Consumer fintech with notable sponsorship of Brazilian football and sports events.

loanDepot is a US non-bank mortgage lender, founded in 2010 and based in Irvine, California, offering home purchase, refinance and personal loans online and through branches under the mello and loanDepot names. It is one of the largest US retail mortgage originators. Listed on the NYSE (LDI), with Parthenon Capital and the founder Anthony Hsieh as major holders. Notable consumer advertiser, with naming rights to loanDepot park in Miami.

Al Ahli Bank of Qatar (Ahli Bank) is a Qatar bank, offering retail, corporate and Islamic banking, cards and wealth services to customers in Qatar and internationally. Based in Doha and listed on the Qatar Stock Exchange (ABQK). Moderate local consumer recognition.

AU Small Finance Bank is an Indian bank based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, originally a vehicle financier, now serving retail customers, small businesses and rural borrowers with deposits, loans and cards through over 2,000 touchpoints. Listed on the NSE and BSE since 2017 (AUBANK), and received a universal bank licence approval in 2025. Moderate consumer awareness in northern and western India.

Deutsche Kreditbank (DKB) is a Berlin-based direct bank, a subsidiary of BayernLB, offering current accounts, credit cards, home loans and investing for retail customers, as well as corporate and infrastructure lending. It has about 5 million customers, and is Germany's one of the largest direct banks. Consumer brand in Germany with sports sponsorship activity.

Eskan Bank is a Bahrain government-owned housing finance bank, based in Manama, providing home financing, real estate development funding and social housing support to Bahraini citizens. B2B2C and owned by the state, with a local brand profile only. The input gives no scale markers, so size and activity should be verified before outreach.

Helvetia is a Swiss insurance group, based in Basel, offering life, property, casualty and reinsurance to private and corporate clients in Switzerland, Germany, Italy, Spain, Austria and France, with about 7 million customers. It merged with Baloise in 2025 to form Helvetia Baloise Holding. Listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. Moderate consumer awareness in Switzerland.

Hua Xia Bank is a Chinese joint-stock commercial bank, based in Beijing, founded in 1992 with Shougang Group as an early backer, offering corporate, retail and financial markets banking through branches nationwide. Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (600015). Hua Xia lists the State Grid and PICC alongside Shougang as major shareholders. Moderate domestic consumer recognition.

LendingTree is a US online loan marketplace, based in Charlotte, North Carolina, which lets consumers compare offers for mortgages, auto loans, personal loans, credit cards and insurance from lenders, earning fees from them. Founded in 1996, listed on Nasdaq (TREE). Known for its consumer advertising in the US.

MeridianLink is a US software company, based in Costa Mesa, California, that provides digital lending, account opening and data tools to banks, credit unions and mortgage lenders, mostly on a software-as-a-service basis. It listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was taken private by Centerbridge Partners in 2025. B2B, known mostly inside financial services.

MSP Capital is a UK financial and wealth management firm, based in Poole, Dorset, providing specialist lending and investment services. Details are limited in the input, with about 450 million funding shown. Customers are professional intermediaries and investors. Low public brand awareness. United Arab Bank is a UAE bank headquartered in Sharjah, offering corporate, retail and trade finance services, in which Ras Al Khaimah and Sharjah-linked shareholders hold stakes and the Sharjah government has historical ties. Funding shown is AED 2 billion. Moderate local recognition.

Braviant Holdings is a US financial technology company, based in Chicago, offering technology-enabled consumer credit products such as installment loans and lines of credit, through its Braviant Capital and Billd offerings for contractors. about: Vivriti Capital is an Indian non-bank finance company, based in Chennai, that lends to mid-market and small enterprises, through debt instruments and a marketplace for institutional investors. Founded in 2017, it has raised around $240 million. B2B, with limited consumer brand.

Aplazo is a Mexican buy-now-pay-later fintech, based in Mexico City, offering interest-free biweekly instalments at online and physical merchants, with its own app and many retail partners. Founded in 2021, it has raised about $210 million in equity and debt. Consumer finance brand with growing awareness in Mexico.

MobiKwik is an Indian digital wallet and fintech company, based in Gurugram, founded in 2009, providing mobile payments, bill payments, credit and buy-now-pay-later and investment products to more than 150 million registered users and merchants. Listed on the NSE and BSE since December 2021. Consumer fintech with notable awareness in India, though it has faced competition from UPI-based rivals.

Fazz, formerly Xfers and Payfazz, is a Southeast Asian fintech group, based in Singapore with major operations in Indonesia, offering payment processing, business accounts, agent banking and payments for merchants and individuals. It has raised roughly $190 million. Business-focused with a growing Indonesian profile.

Baubap is a Mexican microlending fintech, based in Mexico City, which provides small, short-term loans through a mobile app to underbanked consumers. Funding shown is about $167 million. Customers are individuals with limited credit history. Consumer brand with growing awareness in Mexico.

about: Sardine is a US fraud prevention, risk and compliance platform, based in San Francisco, offering device intelligence, behaviour biometrics and payment monitoring for fintechs, banks and crypto firms. Founded in 2020 by former Revolut and Coinbase leaders, with total funding of about $175 million. Customers are financial institutions. B2B with low consumer awareness.

Affin Bank is a Malaysian banking group, tracing back to 1975, providing retail, commercial, Islamic banking and investment banking services, plus asset management and insurance interests. It is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur and listed on Bursa Malaysia (AFFIN), with the Malaysian Armed Forces Fund Board as a major shareholder. It operates a branch network across Malaysia with a few thousand staff. Consumer-facing bank with moderate Malaysian brand awareness and a history of sponsorship of local sport and events.

Enity Bank Group is a Stockholm-based Nordic banking group, described by Crunchbase as a consortium of mortgage banks focused on financial services and mortgages. Funding of roughly 775 million dollars is shown. about: KEB Hana Bank is one of South Korea's largest banks, formed from the 2015 merger of Hana Bank and Korea Exchange Bank under Hana Financial Group. It offers retail, corporate and foreign exchange banking, with a strong position in international remittance and foreign currency services and a network of overseas branches in Asia, Europe and the Americas. Headquartered in Seoul, Hana Financial is listed on the Korea Exchange (086790) and the NYSE-listed ADRs were delisted. Well-known Korean banking brand with a record of sports sponsorship, notably football.

Banco Consorcio is a Chilean financial services group providing banking, insurance, mortgages and asset management to individuals and companies, with a well-known life insurance business (Consorcio Nacional de Seguros) and a bank dating to the late 1990s. It is part of Consorcio Financiero, listed on the Santiago exchange, headquartered in Santiago. Funding around 590 million dollars is shown. Moderately known Chilean financial brand with a middle-market consumer base.

about: Banco Davivienda is one of Colombia's largest banks, founded in 1972 as a savings and housing corporation and now a full-service bank offering retail, corporate, mortgage, credit card and digital banking, with a regional presence in Panama, Costa Rica, Honduras, El Salvador and Peru, after taking over HSBC and Citibank units. Headquartered in Bogota and controlled by the Sarmiento Angulo group (Grupo Bolivar). Listed on the Colombian exchange (PFDAVVNDA). Very visible Colombian consumer bank brand with a red house logo.

Banco Santander Totta is the Portuguese subsidiary of Spain's Banco Santander, providing retail, corporate and private banking, insurance and asset management through branches across Portugal, after acquiring the Totta & Acores and Banco Chemical-related networks and merging with Banco Popular Portugal. Headquartered in Lisbon, it is one of Portugal's three largest private banks, with about 400 branches and around 5,000 employees. Wholly-owned by Banco Santander, formerly listed on Euronext Lisbon. Strong consumer brand in Portugal, known for sports and cultural sponsorship.

Oman Arab Bank is a commercial bank in Oman, headquartered in Ruwi, Muscat, offering retail, corporate and SME banking, personal loans, cards and Islamic banking services through its branch network. It was formed in 1984 and is listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange (OAB), with partner holdings including Omani families and regional institutions. Consumer bank with moderate local brand recognition in Oman. The Crunchbase funding total is probably debt or capital raising.

about: PKO Bank Hipoteczny is a Polish mortgage bank, a subsidiary of PKO Bank Polski, Poland's largest bank. Funding is shown in Polish zloty (about 2.2 billion). Its customers are mostly reached through the parent's branches, so it has limited stand-alone brand awareness, although the PKO name is hugely recognised in Poland.

SEB (Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken) is a leading Nordic corporate and investment bank, founded in 1856 by the Wallenberg family and headquartered in Stockholm. It serves large corporates, financial institutions and private customers in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland and the Baltics, plus Germany, with about 20,000 employees and around 2,000 billion Swedish kronor in loans. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (SEB A), with the Wallenberg-linked foundations as the main shareholder. Recognized financial brand in Scandinavia and a sponsor of sport and tennis.

Spuerkeess, also known as Banque et Caisse d'Epargne de l'Etat (BCEE), is Luxembourg's state-owned savings and retail bank, founded in 1856 and headquartered in Luxembourg City. It serves residents with accounts, loans, mortgages, savings and wealth management, and companies and municipalities, with the largest branch network in the country. Owned by the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. Funding shown relates to capital or bond raising. Strong domestic brand in Luxembourg and a sponsor of local culture and sport.

Al Masraf, officially Arab Bank for Investment and Foreign Trade, is a bank headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, providing corporate banking, trade finance, treasury and retail services, with a focus on corporate clients. It is jointly owned by the governments of the UAE and Libya, among other regional shareholders, and is listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. Mid-sized bank with moderate brand awareness in the UAE, and little sponsorship profile.

It was established in 2006 and is listed on Bahrain Bourse (SALAM). Major shareholders include Bahraini and Gulf investors, including Bahrain's Mumtalakat-linked interests and Dubai Islamic Bank. Moderate consumer brand recognition in Bahrain.

Applied Data Finance (ADF) is a San Diego-based credit and lending technology firm, running the Personify Financial consumer lending brand, providing installment loans and other credit to near-prime consumers through banks and online partners. Funding of about 540 million dollars is mostly debt or warehouse lines. It was founded in 2014 as a lending operation, and has partnered with banks to originate loans. B2B and consumer financial services brand, with limited public awareness.

about: Banco Sabadell is a Spanish banking group, founded in 1881 in Sabadell, Catalonia, with headquarters moved to Alicante in 2017, providing retail, SME, corporate and private banking, insurance and TSB in the UK (acquired 2015). It has about 20,000 employees and operates in Spain, the UK and Mexico, with assets of more than 250 billion euros. Listed on the Spanish stock exchange (SAB). In 2024-2025 it rejected a takeover bid from BBVA. Consumer banking brand with strong Spanish recognition and sponsorships in sport.

Bandhan Bank is an Indian private-sector bank headquartered in Kolkata, which began as a microfinance institution (Bandhan Financial Services) in 2001 and became a universal bank in 2015. It provides microloans, savings, home loans and corporate banking through thousands of branches, with strong operations in eastern and northeastern India and tens of millions of customers. Listed on the NSE and BSE (BANDHANBNK). Founded by Chandra Shekhar Ghosh. Known consumer brand in India with sports and cultural sponsorships.

Bank AlBilad is a Saudi Arabian Sharia-compliant commercial bank headquartered in Riyadh, offering retail, private, corporate and treasury banking and remittance, and is known for its digital retail products. Founded in 2004, it is listed on Tadawul (1140) and holds more than 100 billion riyals in assets, with a branch network across Saudi Arabia. Recognizable consumer bank with a sports presence including football sponsorship in Saudi Arabia.

Global Loan Agency Services (GLAS) is a financial services provider offering loan agency, security trustee, trustee and escrow services to lenders and borrowers in syndicated loan and bond transactions. Headquartered in London, it is part of the GLAS group backed by private equity investors, with offices across Europe, the US and Asia. Customers are banks, funds and corporates. B2B niche service provider with no consumer visibility.
